    Reset all working changes?

    Synchronize Sources

    Sources with a recorded start timestamp are already placed relative to each other automatically, within this Time Group. Use the controls below to add a manual correction on top of that placement, so the same physical disturbance lines up exactly. This never changes a recording's own original data, and a visually synchronized pair of sources does not become mathematically compatible for calculated channels.

    Detect Event Origin

    Analyses one selected analog channel for a sustained disturbance onset and proposes it as a candidate t=0 -- this is a suggestion only. Nothing is changed until you explicitly accept it below.

    A t=0 is already defined. Accepting this suggestion will move it.
